To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) a new form of fuzzy variables, namely intuitionistic fuzzy variables, is defined and analyzed in the credibility space; (2) the TOPSIS based ranking methods are developed for intuitionistic fuzzy variables; (3) a three level fuzzy dominance method is proposed to evaluate intuitionistic fuzzy numbers; (4) two distance based methods are developed to implement the TOPSIS approach; and (5) the consistency and sensitivity of the three proposed methods are analyzed.

the intuitionistic fuzzy ranking methods proposed in the present paper are capable of reflecting the uncertainty and hesitance of the decision makers, while the ranking output is consistent and stable.

the intuitionistic fuzzy dominance method can be applied as a reliable tool in decision making, especially in the case that the decision maker is not certain of the ranking order of the fuzzy alternatives.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the intuitionistic fuzzy theory can be applied to solve real world problems with more complex uncertainties.
the three proposed methods can be applied as a decision support tool for decision makers to rank intuitionistic fuzzy variables in the real world.
the intuitionistic fuzzy ranking methods can help to reduce the uncertainty embedded in the decision making problem, and thus improve the decision making process.
